C2a-R2 blocker. The legacy clip unarmed_parry_success_01_fx has no single canonical identity: its _left sources parry_recovery_01 fx art and its _right sources interaction/success_01 fx art, two semantically different actions under one name. It is live via guard_enter_post_parry_neutral(). Separately, unarmed_parry_recovery_fx is requested but absent from the compatibility resource, so parry-recovery FX has never rendered while canonical art exists. modular_upper_fx_sprite cannot be rebound until both are decided.
